title: Monoidal Categories associated with Kac-Moody Open Richardson Varieties in Symmetric Type
summary: We study determinantial modules associated with open Richardson varieties of symmetric Kac--Moody type. For the seed obtained by the Bao--Ye--Ménard mutation procedure, we give an explicit bijection between its vertices and the positions complementary to the leftmost subexpression. Each initial variable is a multiplicity-one convolution factor of the corresponding determinantial module, and these determinantial modules are cluster monomials in that seed.
